newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell sharply to 1.177 billion yuan from 3.6 billion yuan on Thursday with the 60-day contracts the most active.
Traders said volumes plunged today mainly due to market uncertainties due to rumours that the central bank would shortly cut bank reserve ratios.
The cut would pump tens of billions of yuan into the system and might push down the interbank rates by an average of one percentage points in the short term, they said.
"Both state banks and short-term financial centres were reluctant to build heavy positions due to the rumours," said one trader. "This sentiment depressed trading today."
